research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Europe-led kidswear trade fairs; premium and mid-market childrenswear, newborn to teen
title: SS27 Kids' Assortment and Pricing Strategy
summary: Plan SS27 kidswear for a slower market: durable core, sets that sell together and apart, shallow buys on novelty, and full price for UV and organic value.

sections.heading: The market
sections.body: In Italy, childrenswear exports fell 9.3% and domestic sales 2.6% in 2025 (Confindustria Moda via Fortune Italia)<sup>[1]</sup>. Pitti Bimbo, which once had more than 500 exhibitors, now runs a smaller, more selective format<sup>[2]</sup>. Fashion overall is expected to grow in low single digits in 2027; resale is expected to grow two to three times faster than first-hand fashion through 2027<sup>[3]</sup>.

sections.heading: Assortment
sections.body:
| Tier | What goes in it |
|---|---|
| Core (about half) | Organic tees, stripes, denim, shorts, pyjamas in navy, sand, white |
| Seasonal (about a third) | Swim and UV, sets, dresses, sailor pieces, brights |
| Statement (the rest) | Character and story pieces, party, reversible and novelty |

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body:
- Full price on UPF and certified-organic pieces; show the benefit.
- Value on basics.
- Sets priced to reward buying both pieces.
- Premium on artist prints and hand craft.

design_implications:
- Durable construction supports hand-me-down and resale value.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Track sell-through weekly; chase swim before holidays.
